name: UGC 8215 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 8215, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc8215-hubble
story: A small, irregular galaxy in the loose cloud of galaxies known as CVn I. Hubble picks out its individual stars, and the brightest old red giants among them serve as a yardstick for its distance.

claims.text: UGC 8215 is a dwarf irregular (dIr) galaxy
UGC 8215 is in the CVn I cloud
Hubble ACS images resolve the galaxy into stars and its distance comes from the luminosities of stars at the tip of the red giant branch
